record.question: Which of the following correctly describes GDP and GNP?
options: GDP measures the value of final goods and services produced within a country’s territory, while GNP also includes net factor income from abroad.
GDP measures only citizens’ income, while GNP measures only government expenditure.
GDP includes only intermediate goods, while GNP includes only final goods.
GDP and GNP differ only because of depreciation.
